summary.headline: Twelve Places and Medical Astrology
summary.text: Astrological medical instructions prescribe signs for purgation and vomiting, with Scorpio, Aries, Capricorn, and the Moon’s motion receiving special attention. A list of the twelve astrological places gives their significations, including life, wealth, siblings, parents, children, illness, marriage, death, travel, rulers, friends, and foreign lands.
